title: {Syn} JWST Sees the Universe in Infrared
content:
The James Webb Space Telescope observes mainly in infrared wavelengths. That lets it study cool objects, dusty regions, and very distant galaxies whose light has been redshifted.

Infrared astronomy is not just prettier pictures; it reveals physical processes that visible light can miss.

Why it matters: science facts keeps producing ideas that are simple enough to state and strong enough to build with.
